mainText: Good morning. Futures are mixed this morning. The Dow is up slightly, the S and P 500 is down four tenths of a percent, and the Nasdaq is down about nine tenths of a percent. The driver is Nvidia, with reports that its board is weighing ousting chief executive Jensen Huang, rattling A I stocks. The ten year Treasury yield is about 5.01 percent, up about two basis points from yesterday's close. Biggest premarket movers: Nvidia down about 7 percent on the board reports. CoreWeave down 7 to 9 percent, giving back Wednesday's rally despite strong revenue. A M D up 2 to 4 percent as money rotates out of Nvidia. MicroStrategy down about 6 percent after M S C I said it will remove it from global indexes. Micron down 3 to 4 percent on chip weakness.
